resources.string: ⚠ Real Docker does not work on this device

Docker needs special operating-system privileges (isolating processes and limiting resources) that Android does not grant to any app without rooting the phone. This is not a limitation of Kairos or Termux — it is a security restriction of Android itself. Rooting the device is outside the scope of what this app aims to do, so this module does not install anything: it just explains this and offers the real alternative below.

udocker runs container images (the same ones from Docker Hub: alpine, ubuntu, debian, etc.) without needing root. Isolation is weaker than real Docker, but it works for running most images — it is the same technology the n8n module already uses internally.
